question: Why does one attain full bliss in dance and similar objects?
premises: Full bliss state is obtained in dance etc.
It is attained in the object.
Absence of jealousy, envy, and contraction causes it.
inference: Full bliss is attained because jealousy, envy, and contraction are absent.
plain_english: In dance and similar objects, having obtained full bliss state, she attains it here from absence of jealousy, envy, and contraction causes.
